deal_offers_source_check.name: deal_offers_source_check
deal_offers_source_check.value: source IS NULL OR source = ANY (ARRAY['api'::text, 'email'::text, 'link'::text, 'manual'::text])

mca_contract_signature_source_check.name: mca_contract_signature_source_check
mca_contract_signature_source_check.value: signature_source IS NULL OR signature_source = ANY (ARRAY['external'::text, 'manual'::text])

mca_merchant_upload_links_counts_check.name: mca_merchant_upload_links_counts_check
mca_merchant_upload_links_counts_check.value: max_uploads > 0 AND used_count >= 0 AND used_count <= max_uploads

mca_advances_money_check.name: mca_advances_money_check
mca_advances_money_check.value: principal_cents > 0 AND commission_cents >= 0 AND fee_cents >= 0 AND (payback_cents IS NULL OR payback_cents >= principal_cents) AND (periodic_payment_cents IS NULL OR periodic_payment_cents > 0) AND (payment_count IS NULL OR payment_count > 0)

mca_offer_revisions_money_check.name: mca_offer_revisions_money_check
mca_offer_revisions_money_check.value: (payment_amount_cents IS NULL OR payment_amount_cents >= 0) AND (fee_cents IS NULL OR fee_cents >= 0) AND (commission_cents IS NULL OR commission_cents >= 0)

mca_workflow_webhook_endpoints_flags_che.name: mca_workflow_webhook_endpoints_flags_check
mca_workflow_webhook_endpoints_flags_che.value: notify_originator IN (0,1) AND notify_closer IN (0,1) AND enabled IN (0,1)
